# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large bundle of call snippets, but the **genuine sales-relevant calls are a minority** — most of the audio is internal dispatch/loading/driver-location chatter, Porter delivery-partner support calls, payment follow-up with dealers, and voice artifacts (garbled Hindi/English text, hold-music announcements). After filtering out logistics/ops noise, roughly 40–50 calls carry real commercial content: rate enquiries, product/thickness/color clarification, order negotiation, competitor-price comparisons, dealer rate push-back, and one Porter damage-claim escalation.

Because the surviving sales signal is thin and repetitive (many calls are the same staff quoting the same rate card to different customers), this KB should be read as a **directional, not exhaustive**, training guide. Rates quoted on different days for the "same" product vary by ₹5–₹30/unit — this is **real market volatility**, not an error, and is itself a key coaching point (see below).

The company operates as **Crayon Roofing and Structures** (also heard as "Cryon Roofing", "Rayan Roofing and Structure", "Crayon Roofing Infrastructure" — staff should always confirm company name clearly on call pickup). Core business: **colour-coated steel roofing sheets (GI/GP, JSW-brand coils), polycarbonate roofing sheets, roofing accessories (ridges, L-flash, purlins), welding rods/electrodes (Tata), and self-drilling screws/cutting-grinding consumables** — i.e., a composite steel-roofing + hardware distributor, not a single-SKU roofing company.

## Products & brand ladder

**A. Colour-coated roofing sheets (core product)** — sold under a tiered brand ladder, all ultimately JSW-origin steel:
- **Coloron Plus / Color-on Plus** — flagship branded sheet, "15 years warranty" (`"15 years warranty வரைக்கும் வரும் உங்களுக்கு"`), AZ150, available in 0.40/0.45/0.47/0.50/0.60 mm.
- **Pragathi / Pragathi Plus** — mid-tier, cheaper than Coloron Plus, often out of stock ("Pragathi stock இல்ல, வரணும்").
- **Kalaram Plus (Kalyan Plus)** — another JSW-based variant, comparable pricing to Coloron Plus.
- **Radiance** — competitor/alternate 150 GSM brand customers sometimes quote against Crayon's price.
- **Indra Dhanush (Indrabush)** — value/economy brand, cheaper, used when customer wants "கம்மி quality and கம்மி thickness."
- **Asian / Asian Dhanush** — another economy brand mentioned for price-sensitive buyers.
- **Tata** — explicitly NOT stocked: `"Tata brand available இல்லை Sir நம்மகிட்ட JSW தான் இப்போ இருக்கு."`

Colours repeatedly mentioned: Sky Blue, Off-white/Half-white, Grey, Silver, Dark Green/"Caliph Field Green", Royal Blue, Nova Blue. Staff must proactively ask color + thickness since many calls stall here.

**B. Polycarbonate roofing sheets** — Solid vs Multi-wall distinction is a recurring confusion point:
- Multi-wall: fixed at 6mm, semi-transparent/hollow structure, NOT fully see-through.
- Solid: available in 4/5/6mm, fully transparent ("கண்ணாடி மாதிரி"), used for partitions/cabins needing true see-through.
- Staff explanation line: `"Multi-wall-னா 6 mm. Solid-னா 5, 6, 4-லாம் கூட வரும்."`
- 2mm solid polycarbonate quoted at ₹800+GST/sq meter in one call.

**C. Roofing accessories** — Ridge sheets, L-Flash, Crimp sheets, Purlins (handled by a separate "Kamal sir" for pricing), screws (self-drilling, 1"/1.5"), welding electrodes (Tata brand), cutting & grinding wheels. These are frequently bundled into the same order as sheets.

**D. Steel coils** — raw material side; dealers/sub-fabricators call in about coil weight/section-weight (2.25 ton vs 4 ton coils) — this is upstream procurement, mostly ops, but surfaces in sales calls when "stock not available" blocks a quote.

**E. MS/CHS pipe** — one enquiry call confirms only MS pipe available, not CHS.
